title: Development and optimization of a new culture media using extruded bean as nitrogen source
author: Batista, Fernandes

steps.title: Produce extruded bean flour
steps.instruction: Generate extruded bean flour to be used as the nitrogen source; no further details are provided in the source text.

steps.title: Statistically optimize nitrogen source composition
steps.instruction: Use a mixture‑design statistical approach to determine the optimal percentage of extruded bean substitution for peptone and yeast extract.

substeps.instruction: Design the experimental mixture using Statistica 7.0 (StatSoft Inc.).
Perform each mixture experiment in triplicate.
Analyze results with ANOVA, removing terms with p > 0.05.
Retain only statistically significant terms (95 % confidence).
Assess model quality by the coefficient of determination (R²).

steps.title: Prepare culture media with extruded bean
steps.instruction: Make the new culture medium according to the substitution percentage obtained from the statistical design, ensuring removal of insoluble fibers before sterilization.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve all medium components, including the calculated amount of extruded bean flour, in water.
Before autoclaving, filter the solution through a cellulosic gauze membrane to eliminate fibrous, insoluble material.
Autoclave the filtered medium under standard conditions.

steps.title: Evaluate yeast growth in new media
steps.instruction: Compare the growth profile of the yeast cultivated in the new extruded‑bean medium with that in standard YPD medium.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate yeast into both the new medium and commercial YPD.
Monitor growth (e.g., optical density) over time.
Record and compare the growth curves.

steps.title: Assess media for heterologous expression
steps.instruction: Estimate the suitability of the optimized extruded‑bean medium for heterologous protein expression based on the observed yeast performance.

description: Briefly, the development of the new culture media containing extruded bean as substitute of traditional nitrogen source (peptone and yeast extract) involved the following steps:(1)Production of the extruded bean flour.(2)Use of statistical approach to optimize the composition of nitrogen source.(3)Evaluation of the yeast growth profile in the new media compared to a commercial YPD media.(4)Estimation of the potential use of the new culture media for heterologous expression.
